newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle off $1 at $67, slow - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle off $1 at $67, slow - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow to moderate in the panhandle on Thursday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were $1.00 per cwt lower.

Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 3,800 slaughter steers and 4,000 heifers; 81,400 head confirmed for the week to date including 26,400 formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1200 lbs 67.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1100 lbs 67.00.
Wk to date - 81,400 Week ago - 75,200 Year ago - 123,300
